_doc: Subsystem runs (Dominic 2026-10-20): 2 of the 18 opencode slots port a whole function group instead of one divergence. scripts/subsystem_task.py keeps 2 Subsystem tasks active/queued (refill), at most one run per subsystem at a time, in this order; a subsystem with status 'done' is skipped. Edit status/scope here.

subsystems.title: leader/soldier battle logic
subsystems.scope: the battle state machine of leaders and soldiers (attack/approach/hit/retreat states), return to formation after a fight, ranged fire and projectiles (arrows, cannon balls: creation, flight, impact, damage), and the leader attack-target search (who a leader or soldier engages, re-targeting, engagement end)
subsystems.classes: GGL::CBattleBehavior, GGL::CLeaderBehavior (battle, attack, engagement-end and formation-return states/events), GGL::CSoldierBehavior, GGL::CFormationBehavior, the leader/soldier target-search helpers, and the projectile / flying-effect classes named in recomp/ for arrows and cannon balls
subsystems.files: crates/s5clean/src/combat/ crates/s5clean/src/world/battle_melee.rs crates/s5clean/src/world/leader_tick.rs crates/s5clean/src/world/leader_tasks.rs crates/s5clean/src/world/leader_stance.rs crates/s5clean/src/world/formation.rs crates/s5clean/src/entity/leader.rs crates/s5clean/src/movement/soldier.rs
subsystems.fixtures: combat combat-waves combat-big combat-long ai-long genb-combat-ops genb-waves-assault genb-ailong-mixed

subsystems.title: AI village building
subsystems.scope: the computer player's village/economy building logic: build-order selection, placement search, construction and rebuild of farms/residences/production, worker/serf assignment requested by the AI
subsystems.classes: GAI::CPlayer / GAI village and construction managers, GAI::CEntityDynamic/CEntityStatic order objects used for building, and the GGL helpers they call for placement and cost

subsystems.title: Lua callback system
subsystems.scope: the engine-to-Lua callback system: trigger registration and dispatch, event getters (Event.GetEntityID ...), game callbacks (GameCallback_*), job/trigger timers and the order in which the engine calls them
subsystems.classes: the Lua trigger/event classes and callback dispatch in recomp/ (TriggerFix, event getters, GameCallback_* call sites)
